Les pouvoirs publics injectent 23 millia: The public authorities are injecting 23 billion dinars into an emergency program to modernize the public water service in Algeria. Strengthening infrastructure, acquisition of critical equipment and major desalination and transfer projects are at the heart of this mobilization.
Un enveloppe financière record de 23 mil: A record financial package of 23 billion dinars has been allocated to strengthen the public water service. This emergency program aims to consolidate intervention and maintenance capacities, while guaranteeing the permanent availability of infrastructure. The funds will notably allow the acquisition of electromechanical equipment, generators, hydraulic pumps, pumping stations and tank trucks to meet the immediate needs of the populations.
La réunion a permis de faire le point su: The meeting provided an opportunity to take stock of major structuring projects, including the connection to the desalination stations of Tlemcen, Mostaganem and Chlef. Another flagship project is that of Tinzaouatine, a water transfer over 238 km from the Tanezrouft aquifer. Other strategic transfers are followed, such as the Cap Djinet 2 connection to Bouira, Tizi-Ouzou, M’sila and Médéa, or the transfer to El Eulma via Draa Diss. These initiatives are part of a logic of water security for the entire territory, with projects dedicated to the South-South and Hauts Plateaux regions.
Le ministre de l’Hydraulique, Lounès Bou: The Minister of Hydraulics, Lounès Bouzegza, stressed the urgency of accelerating the execution of projects and strictly respecting deadlines. He called for strengthened coordination between services to prioritize interventions, quickly deal with breakdowns and meet user expectations. “The citizen remains at the heart of the priorities,” he recalled, insisting on the need to guarantee the continuity and quality of public service.
« Le citoyen demeure au cœur des priorit: “The citizen remains at the heart of the priorities of the water sector and guaranteeing the continuity and quality of public service constitutes an essential objective. »
Une mobilisation sans précédent pour sau: An unprecedented mobilization to save the public water service, with massive investments and ambitious projects aimed at covering the entire national territory.
